마지막 표행 — YuE2 instrumental playlist · 1.10.3

먼 길의 새벽 / 강호를 걷는 발걸음 / 저녁빛 머무는 객잔

Generated locally for Last Delivery with YuE2-3B and YuE2-Vae through the
installed YuE2 MLX 8-bit runtime. The playlist requests specify instrumental music.
No reference recording was supplied. The generated masters are preserved;
each request targets a complete 180-second composition. Game copies retain
the full composition with conservative exterior silence trimming, level matching,
a short entrance/closing fade and AAC-LC encoding. Playback runs each track
from beginning to end in shuffled playlist order, independently of gameplay scenes.
There is no circular splice, internal loop or repeated audio padding.
Actual durations and levels are measured after AAC decoding.
The two previous journey/battle recordings were excluded after identifying long
noise/impact-only tails. Two newly generated failed candidates were also rejected.
The delivered files receive full-duration spectrogram and segmented signal
review; build and export require the exact accepted audio hashes.
These checks are not a human audition and do not certify aesthetic quality.

Model attribution:
YuE2-3B: https://huggingface.co/m-a-p/YuE2-3B
YuE2-Vae: https://huggingface.co/m-a-p/YuE2-Vae
MLX implementation: https://github.com/vanch007/mlx-Yue
Installed implementation revision: 9253ed133343406947bde7b67d43c7a63fb39d99
The installed model-weight notice identifies CC BY-NC 4.0 for the checkpoint
weights: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/
This identifies the weight license; it does not assign that license to the
game's code, artwork, or generated recordings.

Generation: scripts/generate-yue2-bgm.mjs. Original requests are preserved in
source_assets/audio/yue2-playlist/requests/. Replacement candidate requests are
in source_assets/audio/yue2-bgm-v1.10.3/requests/ and its attempt-2/requests/.
Per-track source collections are recorded in manifest.json.
Game audio preparation: scripts/prepare-yue2-playlist.py.
Music measurements and source hashes: dist/assets/music/manifest.json.
Content acceptance and rejected-candidate evidence: content-review.json.
SFX: original real-time Web Audio synthesis in dist/audio.mjs.
The previous 1.8.0 deterministic synthesis source remains in scripts/compose-music.py.
